id_scope: UI IDs are local acceptance mechanism IDs, not NASA requirement numbers.

mechanisms.title: Workspace, menus, welcome and license
mechanisms.expected: Menu actions open the intended panels; About/license data match the runtime and shipped license; pending source and Undo remain intact.

mechanisms.title: Resource creation, references and lifecycle
mechanisms.expected: Create, Clone, Rename and Delete preserve typed references and unrelated source; invalid or stale edits recover atomically; Apply/Cancel/Undo and Save/reopen preserve accepted state.

mechanisms.title: Spacecraft configuration and dependent forms
mechanisms.expected: Spacecraft orbit/epoch/attitude/mass/visualization and dependent resource panels apply typed values, reject invalid inputs, preserve pending changes and retain calculated results.

mechanisms.title: Script documents, files, paths and editing
mechanisms.expected: Open, Save, Save As, Unicode paths, independent documents, Find/Replace, focus and Undo operate on the intended document; failures preserve source and file content.

mechanisms.title: Mission tree, insertion, branches and labels
mechanisms.expected: Mission insertion/deletion/navigation preserves nested commands, labels and comments; repeated Apply edits the intended command; invalid edits preserve pending source.

mechanisms.title: Propagation, gravity and atmosphere
mechanisms.expected: Propagator/force selectors maintain compatible dependencies; forward/backward propagation, stops, integrator options, covariance and display colors match checked reports or analytical expectations.

mechanisms.title: Hardware, tanks, thrusters and maneuvers
mechanisms.expected: Tank/thruster/burn controls maintain reference/cardinality constraints and valid frames; test fuel use and maneuver results satisfy their numerical checks.

mechanisms.title: Solar system, celestial bodies and frames
mechanisms.expected: Solar-system/body/coordinate settings and calculated points preserve valid references and reject invalid combinations through recoverable edits.

mechanisms.title: Parameters, arrays and function calls
mechanisms.expected: Scalar, String, Array and function argument controls retain types and ordering; execution checks known outputs and source round trips.

mechanisms.title: Run control, debugger and inspection
mechanisms.expected: Run/Stop/debug controls act on the current mission; breakpoints, stepping, inspection and failure recovery retain the expected runtime state.

mechanisms.title: Targeting, optimization and solver scope
mechanisms.expected: Target/Optimize/Vary/Achieve/constraint controls preserve typed operands and nested scope; solver modes, correction output, disabled blocks and stop/failure behavior satisfy executable expectations.

mechanisms.title: Reports, comparisons and exports
mechanisms.expected: Report selection, search and file comparison preserve complete results; invalid numeric rows/tolerances/errors are diagnosed; exports preserve data and do not overwrite inputs.

mechanisms.title: Plot setup, axes, visibility and live output
mechanisms.expected: Plot controls preserve membership/axes/colors; Toggle and invalid/disabled data rules prevent stale output; exports and pixel/data assertions verify supported rendering.

mechanisms.title: Orbit rendering, drawing and styles
mechanisms.expected: Visible bodies, trajectories, fonts, widths, markers and coordinates follow saved settings; native/fallback geometry and pixel comparisons check supported appearance.

mechanisms.title: Playback, timing, epochs and animation
mechanisms.expected: Playback transport, speed, time scale, parent/child clocks, toolbar visibility and recorded/interpolated states match checked epoch/geometry and replay expectations.

mechanisms.title: Cameras, segments and OpenFrames conversion
mechanisms.expected: Camera defaults/current reset, primary/named views, body-relative positions and segment labels/arc choices preserve supported source semantics and checked geometry.

mechanisms.title: Models, star fields and sensor masks
mechanisms.expected: Model assets/transforms, star styles and sensor-mask geometry follow saved settings; invalid assets/references recover without source loss; pixel tests verify supported native/fallback output.

mechanisms.title: Window and viewer lifecycle
mechanisms.expected: Viewer close/reopen, resize, minimize/restore and final close preserve data and render the expected scene; private/native routes remain distinct from physical host acceptance.

mechanisms.title: Solver plot history and cleanup
mechanisms.expected: All/Current/None/LastN modes and nested solver cleanup preserve accepted trajectories, reports and bounded display history.

mechanisms.title: Stations, FOVs, regions and events
mechanisms.expected: Locator/station/FOV/Region editors preserve typed references, paired data, epoch and file settings; event execution and invalid-input recovery satisfy bounded report checks.

mechanisms.title: Tracking, estimation and covariance
mechanisms.expected: Simulation/estimation/filter/hardware controls preserve valid references and selections; known measurement/state/covariance outputs and missing-file recovery are checked.

mechanisms.title: External force and polyhedron integrations
mechanisms.expected: Supported plugin configuration, file/module selection and source overrides preserve semantics; checked execution and invalid-data recovery remain explicit.

mechanisms.title: Help and attachments
mechanisms.expected: Context F1/Help and offline navigation reach the correct document; local attachments, Find and history remain usable without changing pending mission edits. Help-menu wiki/community/project actions dispatch their reviewed destinations and preserve source/history/results. Report An Issue and Provide Feedback preserve pending state and dispatch the reviewed tracker and mailto recipient/subject.

mechanisms.title: Folder runs and batch results
mechanisms.expected: Folder selection, range/filter/order/function options, cancellation, reports and errors are checked through the delivered batch controls.

mechanisms.title: Diagnostics and isolated-session support
mechanisms.expected: SPICE failure diagnostics retain useful file/context details; isolated Wayland helper normal-exit contracts are checked separately from the GUI.

mechanisms.title: Python call forms
mechanisms.expected: Python module/function/input/output controls preserve accepted syntax and argument order, and check known scalar/Array outputs.

coverage_limits: Test assertions retain their original scope and oracles. Same-engine script equality establishes GUI equivalence, not independent scientific truth.
A named widget reference in a test is only a mapping candidate; observed, shown, changed and activated do not prove checked behavior or human input.
Literal setObjectName declarations omit dynamic names, unnamed controls, delegates, context menu choices and native dialogs. No total GUI coverage percentage is claimed.
NASA historical pass results are never promoted to current Qt acceptance. No row-level correspondence has been verified.

Visible mode uses a controlled Xephyr test-desktop window on Linux, or an explicitly selected native desktop route, with bounded pacing and native-surface snapshots. It is not a full OS input driver or physical hardware qualification.
Local UI IDs group existing evidence. Complete NASA requirement acceptance needs reviewed case-level mappings and the missing tests.

known_gaps.detail: A manual 0.5x XY raster check still fails the original full-color marker oracle after logical-coordinate normalization. Subpixel raster coverage at scales below 1 remains unqualified; registered XY checks cover 1x, 1.5x, 2x and 3x, and a manual 4x check passed. This is retained as a gap, not converted into a passing check.

Historical NASA matrix rows require reviewed case-level mappings and current Qt applicability. Only source-bound, passed proof records receive credit; consult nasa-requirements.json for verified and unreviewed counts. Historical status fields and broad mechanism groups do not close remaining rows.
No verified assertion linkage for every individual widget, menu action and control state. Existing executable assertions are reused and their source files/logs are linked.
Valid, invalid and boundary inputs are checked in existing scenarios; a reviewed input-domain matrix for every editable field is incomplete.
Runtime traces include encountered unnamed widgets, but the static inventory cannot enumerate every generated property row, menu choice, delegate or platform-native control.
In-process Qt events and calls do not verify OS mouse/keyboard routing, native desktop file portals or accessibility. Native-dialog suppression in existing tests is preserved.
Physical Intel/Wayland viewer close/reopen, resize, minimize/restore and normal exit remain distinct acceptance items. Software GL/XWayland/private-display passes do not close them.

See current-acceptance-20261002.md for held tutorial/example objectives, unsupported scientific regimes, legacy data and proprietary/MATLAB dependencies. These are not silently skipped as passes. Custom rotation fixtures isolate frames with an Earth-coincident origin; 1e-8 km relative-input precision at distant astronomical origins remains unqualified, with Ceres-offset failure reports preserved.
This suite runs registered regression checks. Prior tutorial/corpus evidence is linked in the acceptance ledger but their complete authored GUI replay is not automated here.
No full-duration stress/soak, Windows/macOS distribution matrix or all hardware/scale/input combinations is established by this run.
Receipts hash source, binaries and startup inputs; matching source-to-binary provenance requires a controlled build/release receipt.

Automatic visible checkpoints are capped per process. Fast modal callbacks and intermediate edits can finish before native exposure; complete step-by-step visual replay still needs explicit scenario checkpoints. Assertions still execute for those steps.

Native exposure does not prove that every control is inside the visible workspace. An earlier host-scale SearchRouting capture exposed off-edge MDI placement; that fixture now asserts viewport containment. Other fixture layouts, popups, readable presentation and all supported scale combinations still need direct visibility assertions.

The Propagate guide documents epoch time quantization and a warning when requested stopping tolerance cannot be met. The new variational cases request 1e-9 s and observe about 6.98e-8 s reported stop error; they verify the warning and its requested/achieved values. Their state/STM oracles use the actual integration clock. Passing these quantity checks does not qualify nanosecond stopping precision.

The shipped mathematical specification explicitly assumes the relative-acceleration terms are zero in libration velocity, and SpacePoint supplies zero acceleration. New six-state checks qualify that local linear model using an independent position derivative. They do not qualify the full derivative of changing ephemerides or arbitrary nonplanar/nonzero-acceleration primary-secondary motion.

Historical user-body two-body and orbital-element requirements conflict with the current shipped SPICE-only guide and explicit runtime deprecation/read-only guards. The source instances remain reviewed-unverified pending authoritative baseline/retirement reconciliation; no test pass substitutes SPICE for the named removed mode.

The shipped Solvers.tex has empty Differential Correction, Broyden and Newton sections. The new solver cases derive independent finite-difference/Newton oracles for one specified polynomial problem and check all presentation values; they do not replace a complete authoritative NASA numerical solver V&V corpus or qualify general conditioning, scaling, bounds, Broyden or dynamical targeting.

Pending drafts, spacecraft kernel selection/cache, mixed numeric/SPK modes and configured STM/A-matrix/covariance/cardinality boundaries have bounded cases. Remaining: inactive Origin, other segments/general frame-time science, native input/drag-drop, user-body SPK state/cache/precedence (configured list controls now have separate bounded cases) and full current regression.

FRC!E113 unlimited numerical groups requires capacity/stress qualification. FRC!E114 historical ephemeris-count wording needs resource-versus-clone reconciliation with current guide/examples and repeated/distinct SPK support. Both reviewed-unverified.

FRR!E227 historical rotation drift rate and parent E221 remain reviewed-unverified: current guide/core supports spin angle and constant spin rate, with no separate spin acceleration. Bounded orientation GUI/analytic-state cases do not resolve historical nomenclature or retirement.

The registered NativeNasaVF13adResourceReportTruth case fails: final solver report prints2.01 while native/CSV optimum is2 (central reports1.99). Keep the strict assertion active; no WILL_FAIL/skip waiver. Safe repair requires review of the externally provided VF13ad interface source. Configuration/numerical passes do not qualify report truth.
